name: Encainide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and United Kingdom, first in 1991 — for heart harm

similar.name: Thioridazine
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 2005 — for heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm and higher risk of infection

summary: Encainide was taken off the market in the United States and the United Kingdom starting in 1991 due to heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Thioridazine was removed from the market worldwide for heart harm, and it carries a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm and an increased risk of infection [4].
